annotations.exact_quote: we present a deep matrix factorization framework for MVC, where semi-nonnegative matrix factorization is adopted to learn the hierarchical semantics of multi-view data in a layer-wise fashion.
annotations.reason_zh: 摘要明确以深度矩阵分解框架完成多视图聚类，通过可学习的分层表示服务于聚类划分。

annotations.exact_quote: Multi-View Clustering (MVC) has garnered more attention recently since many real-world data are comprised of different representations or views. The key is to explore complementary information to benefit the clustering problem.
annotations.reason_zh: 摘要说明数据由不同表示或视图组成，并强调探索互补信息以利于聚类，显式联合利用多视图。

annotations.exact_quote: semi-nonnegative matrix factorization is adopted to learn the hierarchical semantics of multi-view data in a layer-wise fashion.
annotations.reason_zh: 摘要明确采用半非负矩阵分解学习多视图数据的分层语义，满足非负因子分解机制。

annotations.exact_quote: to respect the intrinsic geometric structure in each view data, graph regularizers are introduced to couple the output representation of deep structures.
annotations.reason_zh: 摘要明确引入图正则器，约束深层结构输出表示以保持各视图内在几何结构，符合图/流形正则化定义。
